mechanism: Output-matrix-only hard-negative margin training with frozen feature-shift preflight selection. The 64-window preflight improved target rank from 2190.919 to 895.808, but the full 2048-window run regressed target rank from 2133.306 to 4072.675.
summary: The frozen rule selected shift 14 after preflight improved target rank, but the effect did not generalize to the full run. On the 512-target audit, mean target rank worsened by 910 per mille and public-development NLL increased by 2,004,452 millibits. The prospective gate failed and denied public test evaluation.
lineage_note: Do not repeat this unregularized hard-negative perceptron schedule at the same horizon. A future bounded attempt would need a fixed disjoint selection surface plus a development trust region or early stop.
